When will I hear about my 2014-15 financial aid?
Questions?
Ask Finaid!
Below are the Financial Aid Notification (FAN) release dates for the 2014-15 academic year. Monitor your email account or check CASH around these dates to review and activate your FAN. Visit Financial Aid Notifications & Aid Release for more information.

Late March Prospective Freshmen
Early April Prospective Graduate Students
Mid April Prospective Freshmen in PACE program
Prospective Transfer Students
Late April Undergraduate and Graduate Students registered for Summer
Late May Continuing Undergraduate and Graduate Students for Fall and Spring

Prospective and continuing student awards are allocated from different funding pools; therefore, awarding prospective students first does not affect funding for continuing students.
